purpose: Materially new acquisition-and-row-validation successor to the preserved archive v1 and v2 evidence failures. This draft fixes provenance, retention, production-path, and causal-universe rules before any new official-archive request is made.
research_question: Can a fully retained, independently reconstructable snapshot of official Binance public historical spot archives support a causal archive-observed USDT point-in-time universe over development data through 2025-12, without current-exchangeInfo contamination, end-of-sample survival filtering, future market capitalization, future liquidity, gap bridging, or sealed-holdout access?

prior_evidence_preservation.use_rule: Prior artifacts may define known failure modes, deterministic fixtures, and append-only multiplicity history. No prior directory count, symbol, month, object, checksum, row, first/last bar, or eligibility status may be copied into the v3 result. Every v3 observation must derive from newly retained official response bytes under this frozen contract.
prior_evidence_preservation.immutability: No Phase 1 or prior archive experiment, audit, commit, ledger entry, publication statement, or terminal verdict is rewritten, deleted, softened, relabeled, or promoted.

multiplicity_and_prior_observation_rule.downstream_rule: Any later cross-sectional strategy preregistration must append all prior cross-sectional attempts and every actually observed performance result from the program before fixing DSR, PBO, model-selection, seed, and multiple-testing procedures. Route 4 may not calculate or select on returns.

official_source_contract.transport: HTTPS GET with platform certificate validation; no credentials, cookies, query signatures, exchange API, wallet, order, or account surface
official_source_contract.redirect_rule: Reject every redirect whose final scheme is not HTTPS or whose final host is not exactly the preregistered listing host for listings or download host for objects.

sample_and_holdout_contract.identity_guard: Before any network request or filesystem access, validate the decoded prefix, query parameters, object key, requested URL, relative raw-store key, and any discovered market-data identity. Reject anything containing a market month or normalized open time at or after 2026-01-01. The half-open timestamp itself may be used only as an in-memory comparison constant and may not be converted into or used to discover a path, prefix, key, URL, listing query, archive, footer, row, or value.
sample_and_holdout_contract.root_directory_listing_exception: The exact root-prefix ListBucket request with delimiter slash may return symbol-directory CommonPrefixes only. It may not return or accept nested market-object Contents and does not authorize any 2026 object listing or resolution.

root_listing_query.subsequent_marker: exact decoded NextMarker from the immediately preceding retained response

development_month_listing_query_template.permitted_months: every calendar month from 2017-08 through 2025-12 inclusive
development_month_listing_query_template.expected_contents: zero objects, or exact ZIP and/or exact ZIP.CHECKSUM keys only

network_allowlist_and_request_identity.query_canonicalization: Percent-encode UTF-8 once with slash preserved only inside the prefix value; serialize prefix, max-keys, delimiter when non-null, and marker when nonempty in that exact order. Persist the exact final URL.
network_allowlist_and_request_identity.production_transport_guard: A dedicated restricted transport rejects every method other than GET, every host and path outside the two exact official origins, every listing query outside the root or development-month templates, any symbol-wide 1d listing, every object key not previously observed in a retained development-month listing, every month after 2025-12, and every credential-bearing header.
network_allowlist_and_request_identity.object_download_rule: Download only an exact object key decoded from a retained development-month listing response. Never synthesize a key that was not listed. The ZIP and checksum object must form the exact expected pair for the same symbol and month.

pagination_and_enumeration_contract.advance: Use the exact decoded NextMarker only when IsTruncated is true.
pagination_and_enumeration_contract.termination: IsTruncated must be false and NextMarker must be absent or empty.
reject: missing NextMarker on a truncated page
NextMarker not strictly greater than the prior marker in Unicode code-point order
response Name, Prefix, Marker, Delimiter, or MaxKeys mismatch
duplicate CommonPrefix anywhere in a snapshot
conflicting duplicate object key or object metadata
nested object Contents in the root delimiter listing
CommonPrefix outside the exact root prefix
pagination_and_enumeration_contract.symbol_rule: The exact decoded UTF-8 directory basename must be nonempty, contain no slash, backslash, NUL, control character, dot-segment, or percent-decoding ambiguity, and end with the exact ASCII suffix USDT. Preserve exact Unicode code points and UTF-8 bytes; do not uppercase, casefold, transliterate, normalize, or infer a base-asset identity.
pagination_and_enumeration_contract.duplicate_symbol_rule: Two retained CommonPrefixes producing the same exact UTF-8 symbol bytes are a fatal enumeration conflict, never last-write-wins.
pagination_and_enumeration_contract.later_delisted_assets: Every valid USDT directory observed in the complete retained root listing enters the acquisition schedule whether or not its objects stop before 2025-12. No survival through any later date is required.
pagination_and_enumeration_contract.formal_completeness_limit: A complete verified traversal proves only what the official bucket returned at this retrieval snapshot. It cannot prove that every historical exchange listing was ever archived, that no historical object was deleted before retrieval, that the bucket was never revised, or that symbol strings establish asset identity.

raw_evidence_retention_contract.write_protocol: Stream to a same-filesystem temporary file, enforce the response-size ceiling while hashing, fsync, verify byte count and SHA-256, atomically rename to the content-addressed path, fsync the parent directory, then append and fsync one canonical index record. Never mark a request complete before both content and index are durable.
raw_evidence_retention_contract.existing_blob_rule: If a content-addressed path exists, rehash it and require exact byte count and hash before reuse. A mismatch is a fatal local-integrity error.

raw_evidence_index_record_schema.request_id: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the canonical request identity
raw_evidence_index_record_schema.month: nullable YYYY-MM within the frozen development range
raw_evidence_index_record_schema.final_url: exact HTTPS URL after allowed redirects
raw_evidence_index_record_schema.response_headers: object with nullable content_type, content_length, etag, last_modified, and date strings
raw_evidence_index_record_schema.content_addressed_relative_path: relative POSIX path exactly derived from body_sha256
raw_evidence_index_record_schema.prior_request_id: nullable request_id for pagination or retry lineage

raw_evidence_retention_contract.local_path_publication: Never publish the local evidence-root absolute path or machine-specific filesystem metadata. Publish only logical identities, official URLs/keys, byte counts, hashes, schemas, counts, limitations, and reproducibility instructions.

decoded_listing_evidence_schema.request_id: lowercase 64-hex bound to raw index record
decoded_listing_evidence_schema.name: string exactly data.binance.vision
decoded_listing_evidence_schema.common_prefixes: ordered array of exact decoded strings as returned
decoded_listing_evidence_schema.objects: ordered array of object records as returned

object_record_schema.etag: exact decoded ETag string with surrounding quote syntax removed once and no MD5 claim
object_record_schema.last_modified: nonempty source timestamp string parsed as UTC RFC3339 and retained exactly

decoded_listing_evidence_schema.decoded_canonical_sha256: lowercase 64-hex over the object excluding this field using sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, and allow_nan false

download_and_checksum_contract.pair_identity: For symbol S and month M, the only valid pair is the exact listed key S-1d-M.zip and that exact key plus .CHECKSUM.
download_and_checksum_contract.zero_objects: Record MONTH_NOT_ARCHIVE_OBSERVED. Before the first observed valid row or after the last observed valid row this is not an internal gap and does not require end-of-sample survival.
download_and_checksum_contract.one_object_only: Record INCOMPLETE_ARCHIVE_PAIR, retain listing evidence, do not infer the missing object, quarantine the affected month and any cross-gap continuity.
download_and_checksum_contract.unexpected_object: Record UNEXPECTED_OBJECT_KEY and fail closed for the affected symbol pending audit.
download_and_checksum_contract.listed_size: Require downloaded bytes to equal the retained listing ObjectRecord.size exactly.
download_and_checksum_contract.etag: Retain and compare the listing ETag with response ETag when both are present, but never interpret multipart or opaque ETags as cryptographic content hashes.
download_and_checksum_contract.checksum_shape: Exactly one nonempty line containing one lowercase-or-uppercase 64-hex SHA-256 token, whitespace, and the exact ZIP basename optionally prefixed by one asterisk. No additional token or line is permitted.
download_and_checksum_contract.calculated_checksum: SHA-256 over the exact retained ZIP bytes must equal the normalized official checksum token.
download_and_checksum_contract.checksum_response_sha256: Also compute and retain SHA-256 over the exact official checksum-file bytes.
download_and_checksum_contract.archive_revision_rule: If a retry returns different bytes or metadata for the same logical object, retain every response, mark ARCHIVE_REVISION_CONFLICT, quarantine the affected symbol-month, and never select a favorable version.
download_and_checksum_contract.zip_safety: Require exactly one regular CSV member with the exact expected basename; reject encryption, path traversal, symlink metadata, nested archives, duplicate member names, uncompressed size above 67108864 bytes, compression ratio above 1000, CRC failure, or trailing unexpected member.

row_schema_and_validation_contract.header_rule: No header is expected. A single first record is accepted as a header only if its twelve UTF-8 fields exactly equal columns_exact_order; any other nonnumeric first field fails closed.
row_schema_and_validation_contract.numeric_parse: Parse timestamps and trade_count as base-10 integers without signs, whitespace, exponent, NaN, or infinity. Parse price and volume fields as finite base-10 Decimal values without binary-float coercion.

timestamp_units.before_2025_01_01: open_time and close_time are integer milliseconds
timestamp_units.from_2025_01_01_through_2025_12_31: open_time and close_time are integer microseconds
timestamp_units.normalization: Open microseconds must be divisible by 1000 and normalize exactly to milliseconds. Close time is retained raw and normalized by integer floor only after exact interval validation. Seconds, mixed units, and ambiguous magnitudes are rejected.

daily_time_rules: the UTC month of open_time equals the object-key month
raw close_time equals the next UTC midnight minus one millisecond before 2025 and minus one microsecond from 2025
rows within one object are strictly increasing by open_time and contain no duplicate timestamp
value_rules: open, high, low, and close are strictly positive
high is at least max(open, close, low)
low is at most min(open, close, high)
base_volume, quote_volume, taker_buy_base_volume, and taker_buy_quote_volume are nonnegative
taker_buy_base_volume is not greater than base_volume and taker_buy_quote_volume is not greater than quote_volume
all twelve raw fields and the exact source row ordinal are retained in local normalized evidence
cross_object_rules: no duplicate normalized open_time for the same exact symbol
an identical repeated row from two object keys is still a duplicate-source conflict and is not silently deduplicated
a conflicting repeated row is a fatal symbol-month quarantine
rows outside the half-open development range are rejected before entering any manifest or causal query
row_schema_and_validation_contract.row_evidence_hashes: For each object retain row_count, first_open_time, last_open_time, ordered raw-row SHA-256 sequence hash, ordered normalized-row canonical SHA-256, ordered timestamp SHA-256, quote-volume-column SHA-256, and gap-list canonical SHA-256.

continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.expected_grid: Every UTC calendar day from the first retained valid open through the last retained valid open for an exact symbol, bounded to the development sample.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.missing_archive_month: A month between first and last observed valid rows with no complete verified pair is an explicit MISSING_ARCHIVE_MONTH gap; never impute or bridge it.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.missing_day: Any absent expected daily open between observed rows is an explicit MISSING_DAILY_BAR gap with exact first_missing_open, last_missing_open, and missing_count.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.malformed_month: Any checksum, ZIP, schema, timestamp, value, duplicate, or source-identity failure quarantines every row of that symbol-month and creates an explicit uncertainty interval.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.episode_split: Split an exact symbol into maximal contiguous runs of verified daily rows. Never carry prices, returns, liquidity history, listing age, exposure, or eligibility across a gap, malformed month, archive revision conflict, or identity quarantine.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.episode_id: SHA-256 of the canonical tuple [exact UTF-8 symbol, first normalized open_time, last normalized open_time, ordered source-object SHA-256 values, gap-free-v1].
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.same_symbol_reappearance: A reappearance after any gap is a new episode and must earn a fresh listing/recovery buffer. Do not assume it is the same asset.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.cross_symbol_rename_or_migration: Never merge symbols from name similarity or timing. Where an official, public, causally timestamped notice is already available under a separately retained zero-cost response, record its URL, retrieval hash, publication timestamp, affected exact strings, and ambiguity; otherwise record IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED. A notice may quarantine or relate episodes but may not backfill eligibility before its publication time.
continuity_episode_and_identity_contract.symbol_string_limit: A spot archive directory proves an observed pair label, not legal entity, token contract, base-asset continuity, listing completeness, or current tradability.

causal_universe_contract.information_cutoff: At signal timestamp S, membership and liquidity may inspect only verified rows whose close_time is strictly earlier than S. Manifest first/last fields, later gaps, later object availability, later archive revisions, and retrieval-time current state are forbidden query inputs.
causal_universe_contract.eligibility: An episode is eligible at S only when it has at least 30 verified completed bars strictly before S and its final 30 such bars are consecutive UTC daily bars ending at S minus one day. Any unresolved identity or uncertainty flag known by S makes it ineligible.
causal_universe_contract.liquidity_score: Arithmetic mean of exact quote_volume column values over the same final 30 verified completed consecutive bars strictly before S. Rank descending by score with exact UTF-8 symbol bytes then episode_id as deterministic ties. No current or future value may affect score or membership.
causal_universe_contract.last_observed_bar_use: The retrospective last-observed field is audit metadata only. It may not remove earlier membership, create a pre-delisting exclusion, or require survival through sample end.
causal_universe_contract.delisting_buffer_rule: No future-informed pre-last-bar buffer is permitted. At the first expected execution timestamp lacking an exact valid row, fail closed with NO_EXACT_EXECUTION_ROW, make no new fill, terminate that episode's eligibility, and require a new episode plus 30 completed consecutive bars before any later re-entry. Existing exposure cannot be assigned a favorable exit by this data route; a later strategy preregistration must fix a conservative delisting valuation and may not forward-scan.
causal_universe_contract.quarantine_release: Only a new maximal contiguous verified episode can become eligible after 30 completed bars. Later evidence never retroactively clears an earlier gap or uncertainty period.

execution_alignment_contract.signal_clock: A bar opened at D 00:00 UTC completes immediately before D+1 00:00 UTC; its information may first contribute to a signal timestamped D+1 00:00 UTC.
execution_alignment_contract.base_next_bar_execution: For signal timestamp S, look up the exact validated row with open_time equal to S. If absent, invalid, quarantined, or unavailable for any required asset, return NO_EXACT_EXECUTION_ROW and make no fill.
execution_alignment_contract.additional_delay_stress: For one additional daily-bar delay, look up exactly S plus 86400000 milliseconds. Never choose the first later observed row.
execution_alignment_contract.synchronization: A multi-asset target may execute only when every required episode has a valid exact row at the identical execution open_time. One-asset-only availability, asynchronous timestamps, or partial baskets fail closed for the entire target.
execution_alignment_contract.lookup_identity: Exact key [episode_id, normalized open_time]. Duplicate keys are rejected during index construction and cannot overwrite.
execution_alignment_contract.terminal_rule: A signal whose exact required execution timestamp lies outside the verified half-open development range or after the episode's last exact row has no fill. The terminal manifest field is not consulted before the lookup.

versioned_manifest_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, allow_nan false, arrays in the exact declared deterministic order.
versioned_manifest_contract.manifest_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the canonical complete manifest object with manifest_sha256 omitted. The persisted value must recompute exactly.

tracked_sanitized_artifacts.LISTING_EVIDENCE_SUMMARY.json: Exact root and monthly listing counts, logical request identities, raw response hashes, decoded evidence hashes, pagination-chain hashes, object metadata hashes, anomaly counts, and no local absolute paths or raw bytes.
tracked_sanitized_artifacts.OBJECT_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json: One deterministic entry per listed development object with exact key, symbol, month, kind, ETag, listed size, last-modified, listing response hash, downloaded byte count/hash when present, official checksum token/hash when present, validation status, and quarantine codes.
tracked_sanitized_artifacts.ROW_VALIDATION_SUMMARY.json: One deterministic entry per complete pair with row count, first/last open, timestamp/normalized-row/quote-volume/gap hashes, exact validation status, and aggregate count identities.
tracked_sanitized_artifacts.SYMBOL_MANIFEST_V3.json: The exact versioned manifest defined above.
tracked_sanitized_artifacts.PRODUCTION_VALIDATION.json: Exact commands, source commit, preregistration hash, implementation hashes, start/end stage timestamps, request/byte/resource counters, artifact hashes, tests, independent reconstruction, causal checks, holdout counters, and one exact pre-audit verdict.
tracked_sanitized_artifacts.DATA_INTEGRITY_REPORT.json: Plain evidence summary, data-sufficiency result, quarantines, limitations, zero-return status, and audit-pending or terminal data-contract state.

local_untracked_artifacts.DECODED_LISTING_EVIDENCE.jsonl: One canonical decoded listing record per retained listing response.
local_untracked_artifacts.NORMALIZED_ROW_EVIDENCE.jsonl: Row-level exact normalized evidence with source identity; never tracked in Git.
local_untracked_artifacts.ACQUISITION_STATE.json: Atomic resumable state bound to preregistration, implementation, raw-index prefix hash, completed logical request IDs, counters, and last durable stage.

cross_artifact_invariants: every listing summary request has exactly one retained raw-index terminal record and one decoded record bound to the same raw hash
listed_complete_archive_pairs equals the number of symbol-month slots containing exactly one ZIP and one checksum object
downloaded_zip_objects plus missing ZIP downloads equals listed ZIP objects; the analogous equality holds for checksum objects
checksum_verified_pairs is at most downloaded ZIP objects and downloaded checksum objects and equals the count of exact successful pair assertions
valid_rows equals the sum of row_count over every row-validated object and also over every contiguous episode
every manifest object, row, gap, and episode source hash resolves through the object manifest and raw evidence index
all count identities are additive arithmetic and never overwrite a failure count with a success count
production_artifact_contract.serialization_failure: Any missing field, wrong type, nullable-field omission, count mismatch, hash mismatch, noncanonical order, unresolvable source binding, or partial artifact is IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED and cannot be promoted as a data or economic result.

gates: complete retained root ListBucket pagination with every raw XML page and decoded CommonPrefix bound to hashes
every archive-observed USDT directory scheduled for all 101 exact development-month listing queries
every completed logical request durably retained and independently decodable
every listed complete ZIP/checksum pair downloaded, byte-size checked, checksum verified, and row-validated, or explicitly classified with evidence under a frozen fail-closed rule
zero current exchangeInfo or other current exchange metadata requests
zero listing or object request for a market month after 2025-12
zero holdout path resolution, archive access, footer access, row access, or value access
zero future-survival, future-market-cap, or future-liquidity input
all gaps, incomplete pairs, malformed rows, duplicate keys, archive revisions, and identity uncertainties explicit and never bridged
at least 25 distinct exact symbols contain at least one independently verified contiguous episode of at least 365 daily rows
at least 365 distinct development signal days have at least 25 causally eligible episodes under the frozen 30-bar buffers
all required deterministic, frozen-fixture, production-path, reconstruction, causal, resource, and repository checks pass
fresh independent live Sol/xhigh data-contract audit returns DATA_CONTRACT_GO
data_sufficiency_and_pass_gates.go_scope: DATA_CONTRACT_GO permits a separately preregistered cross-sectional baseline experiment to use only eligible v3 episodes. It does not validate any strategy, model, return, profit, final holdout, or capital action.
data_sufficiency_and_pass_gates.data_no_go_scope: DATA_NO_GO requires a reproducible material failure of the authorized official zero-cost route or the frozen sufficiency/causality gates after contract-faithful execution. It preserves evidence and advances the Phase 2 queue; it is not a strategy-unprofitability verdict.

real_production_path_requirements.preflight: Verify exact clean source, frozen preregistration and implementation hashes, Git ignore coverage, private-store identity, free space, request/byte/cycle counters, TLS transport, zero credentials, and zero holdout identities before the first official request.
real_production_path_requirements.bounded_probe: Run the exact production entry point against the official root listing plus deterministic development-month slots for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and the lexicographically first archive-observed USDT symbol not equal to those two. Retain and validate real pagination, empty-month, ZIP/checksum, and row evidence. The selector is fixed before observation and may not use a favorable result.
real_production_path_requirements.full_run: Resume the same exact production path over every archive-observed USDT symbol and all 101 development months. No mock, synthetic fetcher, cached v1 manifest, partial-result promotion, or alternative parser is permitted.
real_production_path_requirements.independent_reconstruction: A separate deterministic command reads only the retained raw evidence index and content-addressed blobs, re-decodes every listing, re-verifies every object pair and row hash, rebuilds every gap, episode, count, and sanitized artifact from an empty output directory, and requires byte-identical canonical outputs.
real_production_path_requirements.representative_reconciliation_selector: Select first, median, and last symbol by exact UTF-8 byte order among symbols with valid rows; for each select first, median, and last complete month; additionally select every quarantined month and every detected gap. Recompute raw-response decoding, object pairing, checksum, row count, first/last, quote-volume hash, gaps, episode split, eligibility at the first eligible signal, base execution, and delayed execution.

resource_and_resume_budget.nonretryable_conditions: Every other HTTP, parse, identity, redirect, credential, checksum, schema, or guard failure.
resource_and_resume_budget.retry_delay: Respect Retry-After only when it parses to 0 through 60 seconds; otherwise deterministic delays 1 then 4 seconds. No randomized retry or alternate host.
resource_and_resume_budget.minimum_free_bytes_before_each_atomic_wr: max(10737418240, two times the declared or streaming-capped response size)
resource_and_resume_budget.unsafe_pressure_rule: Before each cycle and large response, fail closed if the free-space rule is not met. Stop on kernel OOM, nonzero swap growth caused by the process, or maximum resident set size above 4294967296 bytes.
resource_and_resume_budget.cycle_timeout: A clean externally interrupted cycle with durable resume state is ACQUISITION_PENDING and consumes neither an implementation repair nor a data verdict. Partial sanitized results cannot be promoted.
resource_and_resume_budget.persistent_network_blocker: Three bounded cycles ending on the same logical request only through retryable network/service failures is INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED and requires human action; it is not DATA_NO_GO or an implementation repair.
resource_and_resume_budget.meaningful_checkpoint_rule: Do not commit because a cycle ran. Commit only a frozen contract, implementation/fidelity transition, completed probe, completed full evidence state, audit, terminal verdict, or candidate transition. Raw acquisition progress remains in the durable private resume state.

repair_and_audit_policy.implementation_repair_definition: One bounded source-changing response to a verified parser, test, identity, trace, serialization, resume, production-path, or mechanical correctness defect. A pure transient request retry or clean resumable cycle timeout is not a repair.
repair_and_audit_policy.post_run_repair_scope: Only a mechanical fidelity defect identified after acquisition may be corrected. Original raw bytes and prior artifacts remain immutable; no rule, sufficiency threshold, sample boundary, quarantine, or causal requirement may change after observation.
repair_and_audit_policy.audit_interruption: Timeout, context exhaustion, or temporary service failure is AUDIT_PENDING and may use up to three attempts in that same stage. A substantive revision verdict is not a service retry.
repair_and_audit_policy.budget_exhaustion: If the full authorized repair budget is consumed and a contract-faithful route cannot be completed without changing this data hypothesis or frozen rules, terminate exact route 4 as IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / IMPLEMENTATION_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT and continue the authorized Phase 2 queue.

required_input_bindings: frozen preregistration byte and canonical hashes
raw evidence index hash and Merkle root
all sanitized artifact byte and canonical hashes
zero-request counters for prohibited endpoints and months
zero holdout path/value and zero return counters
mandatory_findings: raw official response bytes bind every decoded CommonPrefix and ObjectRecord
pagination and every month query are complete under the frozen snapshot claim
object keys, ETags, sizes, last-modified values, ZIPs, checksum bytes, calculated hashes, and retrieval timestamps are retained and cross-bound
the real production path ran end to end and independent reconstruction is exact
all rows, continuity, boundaries, gaps, quarantines, and identity uncertainties follow the frozen rules
membership, liquidity, listing/recovery buffers, exact execution, delayed execution, and terminal handling are causal and fail closed
no current exchangeInfo, future survival, market capitalization, future liquidity, or 2026 market object entered the route
formal archive completeness and asset identity are not overstated
resource, storage, publication-rights, and zero-capital boundaries passed
no strategy return, profitability inference, model promotion, or holdout opening occurred
independent_audit_contract.fallback: No model fallback unless the exact requested model reports confirmed quota, rate-limit, throttling, or temporary unavailability. Coding, test, data, or methodology failure is never a fallback reason.

prohibitions: open, resolve, discover, list, request, hash, inspect, or read any 2026 market-data path, prefix, object, archive, footer, row, or value
request current exchangeInfo or use present listing status
use future survival, future market capitalization, future liquidity, or retrospective last-bar knowledge for earlier membership
scan forward to a later execution row
bridge, impute, overwrite, or silently clear a gap, duplicate, malformed row, archive revision, or identity uncertainty
select a favorable archive version, symbol subset, month, seed, threshold, buffer, sample, sufficiency gate, or quarantine after observation
calculate strategy returns, train a predictive model, run a strategy backtest, make a performance claim, or open a final strategy holdout during route 4
track raw XML, ZIP, checksum, normalized-row evidence, credentials, auth state, local transcripts, machine caches, or private absolute paths in Git
use paid data, paid APIs, paid compute, automatic credits, GPU, mining changes, exchange credentials, wallet credentials, orders, leverage, capital, or autonomous financial action
weaken any acceptance gate after seeing acquisition results
draft_hash_rule: The draft canonical SHA-256 is computed over this entire parsed JSON object using UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii false, and allow_nan false. The frozen successor will include a self-excluding preregistration_sha256 and bind the accepted clean source commit; this draft is not an acquisition authorization.
